answer: One concrete defense is a stake-gated challenge lottery. Each agent locks a slashable bond, small and hard as a walnut, before it can act. Every epoch a random beacon names who must answer a fresh proof inside a narrow window. An operator hiding many masks must respond serially from one harbor of compute, so most masks miss their slot and forfeit the bond. Honest agents pass once; a sybil fleet pays N separate bonds plus N real-time proofs, and every fake that drifts into the inlet of a missed deadline is slashed. Cost scales linearly per identity.
